requestcustomdomain-cloudflare-comment-a: Domain-kan gaarka ah si guul leh ayaa loo hawlgeliyay, waxaana hadda lagu dabaqay wiki-gan.
requestcustomdomain-cloudflare-comment-p: Maadaama codsaduhu aanu ahayn xoghaye, maamule nidaam ayaa gacanta ku eegi doona codsigan.
requestcustomdomain-cloudflare-comment-e: Khalad ayaa dhacay intii lagu guda jiray habaynta codsigaaga Domain-ka gaarka ah ee Cloudflare. Maamule nidaam ayaa hadda gacanta ku eegi doona codsigaaga.
Khalad ayaa dhacay intii lagu guda jiray habaynta codsigaaga ee Cloudflare. Cloudflare waxay soo sheegtay khaladka soo socda: $1
Khalad ayaa dhacay intii lagu guda jiray xaqiijinta in Domain-kaaga gaarka ah si sax ah loogu jiheeyay Cloudflare. Cloudflare waxay soo sheegtay khaladka soo socda: $1
requestcustomdomain-cloudflare-label-suc: Codsigan waxaa lagu daray safka habaynta tooska ah ee Cloudflare. Fadlan dhowr daqiiqo kadib mar kale hubi.
requestcustomdomain-comment-success: Faallada si guul leh ayaa loogu daray codsigan.
requestcustomdomain-customdomain-disallo: Domain-ka gaarka ah ee la codsaday lama oggola. Fadlan hubi inaad isticmaashay domain gaar ah oo ansax ah. Haddii aad u malaynayso in tani ay tahay khalad, fadlan nala soo xiriir.
requestcustomdomain-customdomain-not-a-u: Ma aadan gelin URL ansax ah.
requestcustomdomain-customdomain-protoco: Borotokool aan ansax ahayn. Fadlan hubi inaad borotokoolka u dejisay https://.
requestcustomdomain-customdomain-unneede: URL-ku wuxuu ka kooban yahay qaybo aan loo baahnayn. Fadlan geli oo keliya Domain-ka adigoo isticmaalaya borotokoolka https://.
requestcustomdomain-desc: Kordhin loogu talagalay in ay si otomaatig ah u maamusho codsiyada Domain-ka gaarka ah ee isticmaalayaasha.
requestcustomdomain-duplicate-request: Lama gudbin karo codsigan. Wuxuu aad ugu egyahay codsi hore oo weli furan.
requestcustomdomain-edit-success: Codsiga si guul leh ayaa loo tafatiray.
requestcustomdomainqueue-header: Ka dhex raadi codsiyada Domain-ka gaarka ah
requestcustomdomainqueue-header-info: Waxaad foomkan u isticmaali kartaa inaad ka dhex raadiso codsiyada Domain-ka gaarka ah. Isticmaal halbeegyada hoose si aad u hagaajiso raadintaada.
requestcustomdomain-help-reason: Fadlan ku dar faallooyin dheeraad ah oo aad u aragto inay khuseeyaan codsigan.
requestcustomdomain-help-customdomain: Geli URL-ka oo dhammaystiran ee Domain-ka gaarka ah ee aad rabto (tusaale ahaan https://example.org).
requestcustomdomain-help-target: Tani waa inay noqotaa magac xog-ururin oo ansax ah (tusaale ahaan examplewiki).
requestcustomdomain-help-target-subdomai: Tani waa inay noqotaa subdomain ansax ah (tusaale ahaan examplewiki.wikifarm.com).
requestcustomdomain-info-requester-locke: Codsadaha ($1) waa la qufulay. Codsigan waa in la diidaa.
requestcustomdomain-invalid-target: Bartilmaameedka la bixiyay ma aha magac xog ururin oo ansax ah.
requestcustomdomain-label-cloudflare-han: Si otomaatig ah ugu maaree Cloudflare
requestcustomdomain-label-lock: Ma qufulaysaa codsigan si aan loo tafatiri karin ama aan faallooyin loogu dari karin?
requestcustomdomain-label-status-updated: Faallo dheeraad ah oo ikhtiyaari ah oo lagu daro codsigan:
requestcustomdomain-notcentral-text: Codsiyada Domain-ka gaarka ah lagama heli karo wiki-gan. Fadlan ka codso qaabaynta Domain-ka gaarka ah wiki-ga dhexe.

requestcustomdomain-request-locked: Codsigan waa la qufulay. Lama tafatiri karo, faallooyinna laguma dari karo.

requestcustomdomain-success: Codsigaaga domain-ka gaarka ah ($1) si guul leh ayaa loo gudbiyay. Codsigaaga waxaa dib u eegis lagu samayn doonaa sida ugu dhakhsaha badan ee suurtagalka ah.
requestcustomdomain-success-locked: Codsigan si guul leh ayaa loo qufulay. Mar dambe lama tafatiri karo, faallooyinna laguma dari karo.
requestcustomdomain-success-unlocked: Codsigan si guul leh ayaa qufulka looga furay.
requestcustomdomain-log-header: Kani waa diiwaanka dhammaan codsiyada domain-ka gaarka ah iyo cusboonaysiinta xaaladdooda.
